# HymnFlow

Free, browser-based hymn and scripture display for OBS Studio. No server, no accounts, nothing to install.

### Which download?

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `hymnflow-vX.Y.Z-lite.zip` | **Start here.** The dock, overlay and the KJV Bible. |
| `hymnflow-vX.Y.Z-full.zip` | Everything in *lite* plus the curated public-domain Bible translations. |
| `hymnflow-vX.Y.Z-data.zip` | Bible data only, to add to an existing install. |
| `hymnflow-vX.Y.Z-plugin.zip` | The bare app files (built automatically; no Bible data). |

### Install

1. Extract a zip to a permanent folder, for example `C:\HymnFlow\`.
2. Open `obs-setup.html` from that folder. It shows the exact dock and overlay URLs for your computer.
3. In OBS: **View → Docks → Custom Browser Docks** for the dock, and add a **Browser Source** (1920×1080) for the overlay.

Then drop your hymn files and Bibles anywhere on the dock. The release notes for this version are above, and the full history is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/ebena107/HymnFlow/blob/master/doc/CHANGELOG.md).

Hymn and Bible text have their own copyright: see [CONTENT_LICENSING.md](https://github.com/ebena107/HymnFlow/blob/master/doc/CONTENT_LICENSING.md).
